instruction: Navigate to find information about DMV office locations

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from Virginia DMV homepage to the office locations page. Uses the same evaluator pattern as original (URL regex match via accessibility tree). Similar complexity - requires 1-2 navigation clicks. Regex allows for path variations.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active URL from accessibility tree
Metric function correctly applies regex pattern matching to verify URL
Expected regex pattern is syntactically valid and covers multiple reasonable URL path variations
Data flow is correct: URL extraction -> regex matching -> binary pass/fail result

Minor concern: regex pattern assumes two-level path structure (/category/page) which may be too restrictive - actual Virginia DMV office locations might use different URL structures not covered by the pattern (e.g., /dmv-select, /locations, etc.)
Pattern allows variations in first segment (services/general/about) and second segment (locations/offices/office-locator/find-office) but may miss other valid office location pages
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider broadening the regex pattern to be more flexible, e.g., allowing single-level paths like /locations or /office-locator
Consider adding pattern alternatives that don't require the two-level structure, such as: ^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/.*(location|office|dmv-select)
Validate the regex against the actual Virginia DMV website structure to ensure it matches the real office locator page URL
